# Flash attention, generated by stream-dse

`softmax(q @ k_t) @ v` for every head, causal or not, as one fused group that
[stream-dse](https://github.com/KULeuven-MICAS/stream) places and generates.
The key axis runs in blocks through mlir-aie's flash kernels (`mha.cc`'s
`partial_softmax` and `matmul_PV`), which keep the running maximum, sum and
an f32 output accumulator per query block.

```python
from iron.operators import MHAPrefillStream

op = MHAPrefillStream(heads=32, seq_len=2048)  # d_head=64, causal=True
op(q, k_t, v, output)
```

| Buffer | Shape | |
|---|---|---|
| `q` | `(heads, seq_len, d_head)` | scaled by `1 / sqrt(d_head)` |
| `k_t` | `(heads, d_head, seq_len)` | K transposed |
| `v` | `(heads, seq_len, d_head)` | |
| `output` | `(heads, seq_len, d_head)` | |

The scale is folded into `q`, which is exact and saves a pass over the
scores, and K arrives transposed: a transpose in the graph would be a node
of its own that cuts the fused group.

## What stream-dse is given

The workload is `design.flash_attention_module()`, a `torch.nn.Module` whose
softmax is `iron_stream::partial_softmax` (`iron/common/stream/ops.py`), one
online step over a key block that the exporter emits as a single node. The
mapping (`design.mapping`) gives each layer's kernel arguments and the one
fused group.

stream-dse chooses the query block and the key block from those the kernel
library lists for the flash kernels (`iron/common/stream/kernels/aie2p.toml`);
`query_block` pins the query block. It also chooses where each layer runs,
including splitting the value GEMM over two cores by halves of `d_head`.
With `causal=False` the score GEMM computes every block and `mha.cc` is built
without its mask.

`d_head` must be a width `matmul_PV` compiles and `seq_len` a multiple of the
largest key block; `compatible()` checks both against the kernel library.

## Installing

```bash
pip install -r requirements_stream.txt   # Python 3.12 or later
stream-setup-aie
```

Without these the operator is unresolvable and its catalog cases skip.
